title: Artflow Pro
description:

🔷 ASP.NET API Integration: Robust backend using ASP.NET Web API for high performance and scalability.
🔷 AI-Powered Features: AI-generated social media content and promotional materials.
🔷 User Roles: Artist & Gallery roles with distinct capabilities.
🔷 Free & Pro Accounts: Tiered access with monetization options and enhanced tools for Pro users.
🔷 Real-Time Chat: SignalR-based live chat between users.
🔷 Image Uploads: Optimized Cloudinary integration for image handling.
🔷 Secure Storage: Environment variables and secure storage for sensitive data.
🔷 In-App Purchases: Smooth upgrade path from Free to Pro accounts.

title: Spheres – AI Personal Assistant
description:
Spheres is a smart AI-powered assistant app designed to boost personal productivity through intelligent task handling and seamless user interaction — blending the capabilities of a chatbot with advanced planning tools.

🧠 AI Chatbot Integration: Built on custom prompt engineering, offering emotionally responsive and contextual conversations.
🗓️ Smart Task & Meeting Management: Create and manage tasks, meetings, reminders, and notes with AI assistance.
🔐 Firebase Integration: Real-time data storage, authentication, and notifications.
⏰ Reminders & Alerts: Supports one-time and recurring schedules — daily, weekly, or monthly.
🗺️ Maps & Calendar APIs: Location-aware scheduling and Google Calendar syncing.
🔌 Third-Party APIs: Extendable with external services for added functionality.
👤 User Profiling: Learns user habits to offer better suggestions.
💬 Emotionally Aware Chat: Supports personal, emotional conversations beyond productivity.

title: Webination Business Hub
description:
Webnition is a powerful data-driven mobile application built to visualize and analyze business and personal information across the U.S., offering real-time interaction and advanced UI features.

🌐 ASP.NET API Integration: Seamlessly connects to a powerful backend for real-time data retrieval and complex queries.
📊 Dynamic Data Visualization: Displays interactive pie charts, bar graphs, and line charts across different time frames (weekly, monthly, yearly).
⚡ Performance Enhancements: Includes shimmer loading effects and infinite scrolling for large datasets, like YouTube’s smooth feed.
📍 Location-Based Services: Provides live tracking and shows office locations on map views for both individuals and companies.
📁 Detailed Profiles: Offers insights into company history, office addresses, and verified user reviews.
🇺🇸 U.S. Focused: Designed around American datasets and business ecosystem.

title: CareHub Health Platform
features: Role-based access for caregiver, patient, and family
description:
CareHub is a scalable mobile healthcare app built for caregivers, patients, and family members, delivering essential real-time features and smooth cross-platform performance on Android and iOS.

🩺 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Distinct user roles — Caregiver, Patient, and Family Member — each with tailored views and permissions.
📱 Cross-Platform Flutter App: Built using Flutter to ensure high performance and consistent UI on both Android and iOS.
🔒 Firebase Authentication: Secured sign-in via phone number verification.
💬 Real-Time Chat: Facilitates instant communication between patients, family members, and healthcare providers.
📲 FCM Notifications: Push updates via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
⚙️ Riverpod State Management: Clean and maintainable app logic.
🌐 Multilingual Support: Integrated Flutter Intl for global accessibility.
🧩 Scalable Design: Responsive, modular, and future-proof architecture.

title: BRAKE Automotive
features: Cross-platform app for Android, iOS, and Web
description:
BRAKE is a cross-platform presentation and sync tool that enables real-time slide synchronization across mobile and web devices. It is designed for presenters and audiences to enjoy lag-free collaboration and control.

🎛️ Real-Time Slide Sync: Slide transitions made on one device reflect instantly across all connected platforms — mobile and web.
📱 Cross-Platform Compatibility: Built using Flutter, supporting Android, iOS, and Web from a single codebase.
🔄 Firebase Integration: Real-time state synchronization for connected users and live interactions.
🔐 ASP.NET API Backend: Securely handles user auth, session logic, and data transmission.
🔁 Two-Way Control: Presenters can operate slides from mobile or web devices.
📶 Multi-Device Login: Simultaneous login from different devices to manage or view sessions.

title: BuySpy Marketplace
description:
BuySpy is a real-time eCommerce companion app built to track and alert users about active product listings on eBay. Designed with a focus on deal-hunting and user convenience, it brings live sales directly to your device.

🛒 eBay API Integration: Fetches and displays live product listings from eBay in real time, mimicking an eBay-like browsing experience.
📱 Cross-Platform Flutter App: Deployed for both Android and iOS, ensuring a consistent and smooth interface across devices.
🔔 Configurable Notification Alerts: Users can choose how frequently they receive notifications — 1, 5, 15, 30 minutes, or 1 hour.
📡 Firebase Cloud Messaging: Push notifications for product changes or new listings.
🔐 ASP.NET Backend: Handles API request management, user data processing, and scheduling logic securely and efficiently.
⚡ Real-Time Tracking: Instantly alerts users to price drops or new deals, keeping them ahead in the competitive buying process.

title: Seabee Learning
description:
Seabee Study is an educational mobile app designed for university students to practice and master course-related MCQs in real time. It supports progress tracking, scoring analytics, and tiered access levels for both casual learners and advanced users.

📘 MCQ-Based Learning: Offers a rich bank of university-level multiple-choice questions, divided into Basic and Advanced phases to suit all learners.
⚡ Real-Time Scoring: Users receive instant feedback and scores upon answering, helping reinforce learning through immediate correction.
🔥 Firebase Integration:
– Real-time Database for syncing MCQs, scores, and user progress.
– Authentication to manage account types (Free vs. Pro).
📊 Progress Tracking: Displays individual learning analytics, scores, and performance trends to monitor academic improvement.
🔓 Tiered Access:
– Free Account: Access to basic MCQs and features.
– Pro Account: Unlocks advanced question sets, detailed analytics, and priority content updates.

title: Carbid Marketplace
description:
Carbid is a real-time product auction app designed for a global audience, offering live bidding, real-time chat, and multilingual support to enhance the online buying and selling experience.

🚗 Live Bidding System: Users can bid on products in real time, with instant updates on auction status and pricing.
💬 Real-Time Communication: Integrated SignalR in Flutter to support live chat and synchronized bidding notifications across devices.
🔐 ASP.NET API Integration: Manages backend operations including bidding logic, product listings, and user sessions securely and efficiently.
🌐 Internationalization & Localization:
– Supports multiple languages and regions, enabling a globally accessible platform.
– Dynamically adapts text and formats based on the user's locale.
⚡ Seamless User Experience: Real-time interactivity delivers a smooth and engaging buying/selling environment across all supported countries.

title: Wedding Planner Pro
description:
Wedding Planner is an elegant and intuitive mobile app designed to help users effortlessly organize their weddings. It offers a feature-rich, visually appealing experience that transforms complex planning into a joyful journey.

💍 Flutter-Powered UI: Built with Flutter for a smooth, responsive, and consistent experience across Android and iOS.
🔥 Firebase Integration:
– Real-time data management for tasks, guests, budgets, and event timelines.
– Cloud Messaging to send personalized reminders and updates.
📅 Smart Task Scheduling: Keeps users on track with important milestones and deadlines using an intuitive planning system.
🎨 Engaging User Experience: Designed with a clean and romantic UI to make wedding planning enjoyable and stress-free.
🔔 Reminders & Notifications: Helps users stay organized with timely alerts for meetings, bookings, and important dates.
